meta_description: Blush emoji ☺️ 😊 😳, shy and flattered reaction sets, plus typed blushing emoticons like :$ for bashful chats and replies. Click any symbol to copy it instantly.
hero_tagline: Rosy-cheeked smiles, shy hidden faces, flustered reactions, and typed :$ emoticons: every shade of bashful. Click any symbol to copy it instantly.
intro: The blush emoji is how you say 'you're making me shy' without a single word: a warm ☺️ smile, the smiling eyes of 😊, or the wide-eyed pink rush of 😳 flushed cheeks. This page gathers the whole bashful range: the shy hide-behind-your-hands reactions like 🙊 and 🫣, the warm and flattered faces for a genuine compliment, typed :$ emoticons, and a few blushing kaomoji like (灬°ω°灬) that paste anywhere plain text works. Grab a single face, or copy a ready-made combo set for sweet chats, comments, and replies.
